title: Harp-Shaped Pin
summary: Insert a Harp-Shaped Pin into the desk in Elerrathin’s Home to open Jaheira’s hidden basement.

fields.Access: DC 12 Perception to detect the slot in the garden-room desk. Insert the pin to release the hidden passage.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
